release_candidate.tag_target_policy: Tag the final commit only after that commit's post-push GitHub Actions run passes. A committed file cannot truthfully contain the SHA and CI URL of its own future commit.
release_candidate.notes: The evidence-bearing checkpoint satisfies the documented strict v0 gates, and the latest pre-release head was also checked. Hosted leaderboard operation, rotating holdouts, and v1/community claims remain separate work.

evidence.protected_private_holdout_execution_sour: Two same-commit no-tools summaries prove macOS host private-path denial and support one eligible private leaderboard row. One host-isolated live tool-agent summary reports 24/24 target-request correlation. The combined three-summary protected-evidence validator passes with host isolation and the tool-agent requirement enabled.
evidence.notes: The strict maintainer gate is evidence-ready at the referenced checkpoint and was rechecked on the latest pre-release head. The final v0.0 tag target must be the pushed commit whose GitHub Actions run passes after this release-evidence wording commit.
